blocks.text: High quality sound and comfortable, all-day listening in a wireless headphone. The WH-CH520 have an ultra-long battery life of up to 50 hours and a 3-minute quick charge gives you up to 1.5 hours of audio playback.

items.label: LONG BATTERY LIFE
items.value: With up to 50-hour battery life and quick charging, you’ll have enough power for multi-day road trips and long festival weekends. (USB Type-C Cable included)

items.label: HIGH QUALITY SOUND
items.value: Great sound quality customizable to your music preference with EQ Custom on the Sony | Headphones Connect App.

items.label: LIGHT & COMFORTABLE
items.value: The lightweight build and swivel earcups gently slip on and off, while the adjustable headband, cushion and soft ear pads give you all-day comfort.

items.label: CRYSTAL CLEAR CALLS
items.value: A built-in microphone provides you with hands-free calling. No need to even take your phone from your pocket.

items.label: MULTIPOINT CONNECTION
items.value: Quickly switch between two devices at once.

items.label: AVAILABLE IN SIX COLORS
items.value: With Black, Blue, White, Pink, Yellow and Cappuccino to choose from, find the color that suits you best.

items.label: GIVE YOUR MUSIC A BOOST
items.value: Boost the quality of compressed music files and enjoy streaming music with high quality sound through DSEE.

items.label: FIND YOUR HEADPHONES WITH FAST PAIR
items.value: Easily find your missing headphones by sound or check their last known location in Google’s Find My Device app on your smartphone.

items.label: EASY CONNECTION TO YOUR PC
items.value: Swift Pair makes it quick and easy to pair your headphones with your Windows 10 computer via Bluetooth.

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: Headphones, USB Type-C cable (USB-A to USB-C) (approx. 20 cm (7.88 in.))
